title: Done.
text: I tried to give the benefit of the doubt here, but I cant keep my subscription anymore. You had 80 years of material to pick from, and you give us two characters that have already been made multiple times and a t shirt of a character already depicted in pop form and on shirts. Way to reach into the depths of marvel and pick something special. Why not give us creator pops like ditko, kirby, romita instead of ANOTHER thanos and ANOTHER loki. The pin was cool, but the decal is weak. This could have been so good with nearly endless possibilities, but you chose to be lazy and press the button on the pop maker that is nearly worn out from being used too much. Thanks for nothing.
label: negative
